prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 临床试验 · 分组与随访 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "试验组（低剂量）" spans 1 col × 3 row; "对照组" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "分组" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "访视" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 3: header "时间窗" · longest unbreakable word 30px · one-line width 56px
  col 4: header "检查项目" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 399px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"呈现临床试验各分组的访视时间窗和检查项目，便于核对随访安排。","reading":"读者先按分组纵向查找，再横向读取每次访视的时间窗和检查项目，也可对照两组在相同时间点的安排。合并的分组单元格可利用多行访视的高度容纳换行。","groups":["分组与访视共同确定一条随访记录；分组标签跨行，访视标签逐行变化。","时间窗与检查项目共同说明该次访视的安排，需保持清晰的行对应关系。"],"keep_intact":["D0、D28 ± 3、D84 ± 7等时间标识及其容差","基线、随访等简短访视名称","检查项目中的单个医学术语"],"may_wrap":["试验组（低剂量）可在组名与剂量说明之间换行","较长的访视名称可自然换行","检查项目列表可在项目之间换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [78, 72, 88, 121] · table 360×358px · row heights [36, 60, 129, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [72, 82, 88, 117] · table 360×358px · row heights [36, 60, 129, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [72, 67, 88, 132] · table 360×335px · row heights [36, 60, 106, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"表头均保持单行；时间窗完整，检查项目中的医学术语没有被拆开。分组跨行后，读者仍能按访视逐行核对。","problems":"首次随访的检查项目占五行，形成很高的一行；分组标签中的剂量说明也被拆成多行，访视名称换行。","cause":"检查项目列只有121px，限制了长列表的排布；分组列78px和访视列72px不足以容纳各自较长的标签。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"时间窗和检查项目中的术语保持完整，表头清楚，跨行分组关系容易辨认。","problems":"长检查项目仍占五行；访视列比r1A更宽，却没有减少首次和第二次随访名称的换行，分组标签仍较零碎。","cause":"访视列增至82px仍不足以容纳完整的较长访视名称，同时检查项目列缩至117px，没有改善最高行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"检查项目列更宽，最长单元格降至四行，首次随访一行的高度更适中，整表的纵向节奏有所改善。","problems":"检查项目中的“肝肾功能”和较长叙述被拆开，降低了医学内容的可读性；分组和较长访视名称仍分行。","cause":"检查项目列虽增至132px，但文本区约111px，恰好使部分术语落在行尾并被拆开；分组列72px、访视列67px也较窄。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"检查项目优先","widths":[72,67,78,142],"change":"从时间窗列回收10px给检查项目列；78px仍可容纳56px的一行时间窗内容和21px内边距与边框，检验更宽的项目列能否改善术语断行。"},{"name":"兼顾分组","widths":[78,67,78,136],"change":"保留较宽的分组列，同时缩减时间窗列并加宽检查项目列，观察分组标签与医学术语的整体换行是否更协调。"},{"name":"访视与项目折中","widths":[72,77,78,132],"change":"将时间窗列节省的宽度用于访视列，保持r1C的检查项目宽度，检验访视标签换行是否改善，并与检查项目优先方案比较。"}]}
